objects.description: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has attempted to get users to open malicious PDF attachment and to enable macros and launch malicious Microsoft Word documents delivered via spearphishing emails.(Citation: Unit 42 MuddyWater Nov 2017)(Citation: FireEye MuddyWater Mar 2018)(Citation: Securelist MuddyWater Oct 2018)(Citation: Talos MuddyWater May 2019)(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater June 2019)(Citation: Reaqta MuddyWater November 2017)(Citation: Anomali Static Kitten February 2021)(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021)(Citation: DHS CISA AA22-055A MuddyWater February 2022)(Citation: Talos MuddyWater Jan 2022)(Citation: Proofpoint TA450 Phishing March 2024) Additionally, [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used a Word document with a malicious Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) macro; when enabled, the CertificationKit.ini payload is constructed and executed.(Citation: CloudSEK_RustyWater_Jan2026)
objects.description_fa: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) تلاش کرده است تا کاربران را وادار کند که پیوست PDF مخرب را باز کنند و ماکروها را فعال کند و اسناد مخرب Microsoft Word را که از طریق spearphishing تحویل داده شده است راه اندازی کند. ایمیل‌ها.(Citation: Unit 42 MuddyWater Nov 2017)(Citation: FireEye MuddyWater Mar 2018)(Citation: Securelist MuddyWater Oct 2018)(Citation: Talos MuddyWater May 2019)(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater June 2019)[[[CTI_ PRESERVE_5]]](Citation: Anomali Static Kitten February 2021)(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021)(Citation: DHS CISA AA22-055A MuddyWater February 2022)(Citation: Talos MuddyWater Jan 2022)(Citation: Proofpoint TA450 Phishing March 2024) علاوه بر این، [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) از یک سند Word با یک ماکرو Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) مخرب استفاده کرده است. وقتی فعال باشد، بارگذاری CertificationKit.ini ساخته و اجرا می‌شود.(Citation: CloudSEK_RustyWater_Jan2026) (Citation: Reaqta MuddyWater November 2017)
